title: Login from new country after travel notice
description: [SYNTHETIC] User m.rivera signed in from Lisbon, PT at 08:12 UTC using the corporate VPN-bypass profile. The account has no prior sign-ins from PT. MFA prompt was approved on the registered phone. HR calendar shows an approved business trip to Lisbon this week.

title: Repeated failed logins followed by success from unfamiliar IP
description: [SYNTHETIC] 43 failed sign-in attempts for account svc-backup over 6 minutes from 203.0.113.58, followed by a successful sign-in from the same address. The address has no prior history with this account. MFA is not enforced on this service account. Immediately after sign-in, the account was added to the 'Backup Operators' group.

title: Unusual data transfer volume from workstation
description: [SYNTHETIC] Workstation WKS-0147 uploaded 2.3 GB to an external cloud-storage domain between 22:05 and 22:40 UTC. Network logs show the transfer, but endpoint telemetry for the same window is missing because the agent was offline. The owner is a contractor whose assignment status is not recorded in the alert.

title: Password spray pattern against VPN gateway
description: [SYNTHETIC] 112 accounts each received 1-2 failed VPN sign-ins from 198.51.100.24 within 20 minutes. No successful sign-ins from this address were observed.

title: Scheduled vulnerability scan flagged as port sweep
description: [SYNTHETIC] Host 10.20.4.15 probed 1,024 ports across 40 internal servers between 01:00 and 01:20 UTC. The change calendar lists a weekly authenticated vulnerability scan from this scanner at the same time.

title: Privilege escalation: user added to Domain Admins
description: [SYNTHETIC] Account j.okafor was added to 'Domain Admins' at 16:48 UTC by account helpdesk-tier1. Helpdesk-tier1 does not normally hold rights to modify this group. No change ticket is referenced.

title: Impossible travel between two sign-ins
description: [SYNTHETIC] Account t.nguyen signed in from Singapore at 09:02 UTC and from Frankfurt at 09:40 UTC. The Frankfurt sign-in used a commercial VPN exit node. Both sign-ins passed MFA.

title: Malware signature match on email attachment
description: [SYNTHETIC] Mail gateway quarantined invoice_4471.xlsm sent to a.patel. Attachment matched a generic macro-downloader signature. The message was quarantined before delivery. No endpoint execution events were recorded.

title: Service account interactive login
description: [SYNTHETIC] Account svc-reporting, normally used only for scheduled jobs, started an interactive RDP session on APP-DB-02 at 03:30 UTC. A database maintenance window is listed for APP-DB-02 that night, but the owner of the session is not recorded.

title: New admin API key created
description: [SYNTHETIC] An administrator API key was created for the billing application by s.kim at 14:22 UTC from the corporate network. The key was created through the standard admin console and a matching change request CHG-2291 is approved.

title: Large number of file deletions on shared drive
description: [SYNTHETIC] 1,860 files were deleted from the Finance shared drive by user d.hassan within 4 minutes. Cloud backup shows the files remain recoverable. The deletion followed a folder-restructuring request noted in a chat message that is not attached to the alert.

title: DNS queries to newly registered domain
description: [SYNTHETIC] Host WKS-0310 made 14 DNS queries to a domain registered 3 days ago, at regular 5-minute intervals. The domain has no web reputation data available.
